candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because the order service returns 502, which is caused by the payment service returning 503 on POST /v1/authorizations; the failing hop is payment, not gateway or inventory.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 propagating up, but the underlying payment fault (config, saturation, dependency) is not observed.

report.explanation: All three checkout traces show the same chain: gateway /v1/checkout 502, order 502, payment 503 on /v1/authorizations, while inventory reservation succeeds. Gateway logs confirm 502 client errors to order. The bounded cause is a payment-side 5xx, but the specific payment fault is unobserved.
